issues.description: Method name mismatch for the operation that adds a StockIngredient to the stock. The problem statement UML declares Stock.+addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient): void (problem_statement.md), and the reference solution implements Stock.addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) and calls it from SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery. The template implementation instead provides a method named addItem(StockIngredient) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java. This naming inconsistency (addToStockIngredients vs addItem) will confuse students and may cause compilation or runtime errors if test code or student code uses the UML/solution name while the template only exposes the different identifier.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Preferred fixes:
1) Update the template to add a public method with the UML/solution name: public void addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient ingredient) that appends the ingredient to stockIngredients (e.g., delegate to the existing addItem logic or directly use ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray). This preserves the existing template behavior and matches the UML/solution. 
OR
2) If addItem is the intended name, update the problem statement UML and the solution to use addItem consistently. Ensure all call sites (SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery and tests) use the chosen name.
